temporal_notes: Monthly collections from January 2006 to December 2008 (prior to and immediately following LLIN rollout in July 2008)
coord_source_text: Briefly, the village of Dielmo (13°43'N, 16°24'W) is located 280 km southeast of Dakar and about 15 km north of the Gambian border in an area of Sudan-type savannah.
source_text: Adult mosquitoes were collected monthly from January 2006 to December 2011. Night human landing catches (HLC) were conducted two or three nights each month, between 7:00 PM and 7:00 AM, in two indoor and two outdoor sites.
